description: Ruy Lopez兑换变例 C68 — 象换马制造叠兵：战略性兑换的长期价值

intro.popup_en:
Timely Exchanges, Lesson 1
In the Ruy Lopez, White plays Bb5 to target Nc6, then chooses Bxc6 to exchange bishop for knight. White gives up the bishop pair; what is gained? Black receives doubled c-pawns, a structural weakness that can persist throughout the game. Is this exchange worthwhile now?
intro.popup:
及时兑子 第1课

西班牙开局——白方第3手走Bb5
瞄准黑方Nc6

白方第4手：Bxc6！
主动用象换马！

直接损失：放弃双象优势
获得的是什么？

制造黑方叠兵 c6+c5
这个结构弱点将伴随整局！

⭐ 及时兑子的核心问题：
这次兑换现在值得吗？

outro.popup_en: The first model of a useful exchange: Bxc6 creates doubled c-pawns that can become endgame weaknesses. White simplifies actively when the structure is favorable. Before exchanging, ask what structural benefit you gain, whether the opponent can repair it, and whether this is the best moment.
outro.popup:
Ruy Lopez兑换总结

及时兑子的第一模式：

① 战略目的明确：Bxc6制造叠兵
② 叠兵是残局弱点（c6+c5不可移动）
③ 白方主动兑后简化——有利局面入残局

兑换前问自己：
① 这次兑换对我有什么结构好处？
② 对方能修复这个弱点吗？
③ 现在是兑换的最佳时机吗？

这就是及时兑子的三个核心问题！

moves.popup_en: e4 occupies the center.
moves.popup: e4 占中心

moves.popup_en: ...e5 mirrors White's central advance.
moves.popup: e5 对称回应

moves.popup_en: Nf3 develops and attacks e5.
moves.popup: Nf3 发展马，攻击e5

moves.popup_en: ...Nc6 develops and defends e5.
moves.popup: Nc6 保护e5，发展马

moves.popup_en: Bb5! The Ruy Lopez bishop pins Nc6, the main defender of e5. If the knight moves, the e5-pawn is left undefended. White waits rather than exchanging immediately.
moves.popup:
Bb5！西班牙开局！
象钉住Nc6——
如果Nc6移动，e5兵悬空

⭐ 注意：白方并没有立刻Bxc6
而是先钉住，伺机而动

moves.popup_en: ...a6 asks the bishop to choose: stay on b5 or exchange on c6.
moves.popup:
a6 质问象的去向
黑方迫使白方表态：
留在b5，还是Bxc6兑换？

moves.popup_en: Bxc6!! White chooses the exchange when ...a6 forces the bishop to decide. White gives up the active bishop pair, but creates doubled c-pawns and makes Black recapture with the d-pawn, delaying its development.
moves.popup:
Bxc6！！白方主动兑换！

⭐ 关键决策时刻！
白方选择了兑换——为什么？

损失：放弃活跃象（双象优势消失）
收益：
① 黑方c列形成叠兵（c6+c5）
② 黑方必须用兵回吃，d兵不能发展

⭐ 及时兑子的时机：a6已迫使象必须表态，现在是兑换的最好时机！

moves.popup_en: ...dxc6 recaptures with the d-pawn. Black now has doubled c-pawns, a semi-open d-file for White, and a weakened d5-square.
moves.popup:
dxc6 黑方用d兵回吃

⭐ 关键结果：
① 黑方c列叠兵出现：c6+c5（将来）
② d线开放给白方半开放
③ 黑方d兵消失，d5格变成白方强格

叠兵的代价：终身结构弱点

moves.popup_en: O-O! White secures the king and prepares to attack.
moves.popup:
O-O 白方先入城！
稳固王的安全，准备攻击

moves.popup_en: ...f6 supports e5 and reinforces the center, but also weakens Black's kingside.
moves.popup:
f6 黑方f6保护e5
加固中心——但f6也削弱了黑方王翼

moves.popup_en: d4! White challenges the center, opens the d-file, and establishes d5 as a potential outpost.
moves.popup:
d4！中心对抗！
开放d列，d5格成为白方强格

⭐ 叠兵的弱点开始显现：
黑方c6兵无法向前参与中心战斗

moves.popup_en: ...exd4 exchanges in the center and opens the d-file.
moves.popup:
exd4 中心兑换
黑方吃掉d4，d列开放

moves.popup_en: Nxd4 places White's knight on the strong central square d4. Black's doubled pawns cannot challenge this outpost, and White controls the d-file.
moves.popup:
Nxd4 白方马占强格d4

⭐ d4/d5强格：
黑方叠兵无法攻击这些格！
d列完全归白方控制

moves.popup_en: ...c5 advances the doubled pawn pair. It gains activity but further weakens b5 and d5, a double-edged choice.
moves.popup:
c5！叠兵推进！

⭐ 叠兵开始活动——
但这也进一步削弱了b5和d5格
叠兵活跃是把双刃剑

moves.popup_en: Ne2! White reorganizes the knight, preparing Ng3 or Nc3 for a more useful placement.
moves.popup:
Ne2 马重组！
准备Ng3或Nc3，获得更好位置

moves.popup_en: Qxd1!! White offers a queen trade while structurally better. The doubled pawns become harder to defend in the endgame; this is White's second key decision to simplify.
moves.popup:
Qxd1！！白方主动兑后！

⭐ 及时兑子的另一面：
有利局面时，主动简化！
兑后进入残局——叠兵弱点在残局中更明显！

这是白方的第二次关键兑换决策

moves.popup_en: Rxd1 places the rook on the d-file.
moves.popup:
Rxd1 车占d列

⭐ d列归白：
白方车控制d列，黑方叠兵受压

moves.popup_en: ...Bd6 develops the bishop and protects e5.
moves.popup: Bd6 黑象发展，保护e5

moves.popup_en: f3 stabilizes White's center and prepares Be3 and a knight reroute to d4.
moves.popup:
f3 白方f3稳固中心
准备Be3+Nd4重组

moves.popup_en: ...Ne7 reorganizes Black's knight, with d5 or f5 in mind.
moves.popup: Ne7 黑马重组，支持d5或f5

moves.popup_en: Be3! White's bishop occupies an active square, controlling d4 and c5.
moves.popup: Be3！象占强格，控制d4和c5

moves.popup_en: ...b6 supports c5, but leaves b5 weaker and available as a potential outpost for White's knight.
moves.popup:
b6 黑方b6巩固c5
但b5格变弱——白方马可以占b5！

moves.popup_en: Nd2 reorganizes the knight, preparing Nb3 to attack c5 or a route to d5.
moves.popup:
Nd2 马重组！
准备Nb3攻击c5或进入d5

moves.popup_en: ...Bb7 repositions the bishop to participate along the long diagonal.
moves.popup:
Bb7 黑象转移
通过b7参与中心

moves.popup_en: Nf1 continues White's knight reroute as all the pieces improve their positions.
moves.popup:
Nf1 马继续重组
白方所有子力稳步改善位置

moves.popup_en: ...O-O-O! Black castles long and brings the king to safety on c8.
moves.popup:
O-O-O！黑方长易位！
王在c8，寻求安全

⭐ 局面评估：
白方结构优势，叠兵是永久弱点
残局中白方的技术优势将逐渐转化

moves.popup_en: Ng3! White's knight reaches a strong square, controlling f5 and h5.
moves.popup:
Ng3！马占用最佳格
控制f5和h5

moves.popup_en: ...g6 weakens Black's kingside. White's structural edge from Bxc6 is now showing: doubled pawns, central outposts, and a favorable queenless endgame.
moves.popup:
g6 黑方g6削弱王翼

⭐ 总结：
第4手Bxc6的战略价值在整个残局中逐步体现！
叠兵 → d5强格 → 主动兑后 → 残局优势！

这就是及时兑子：
在正确的时刻，为了正确的理由，做出正确的兑换！
